declare

 then

 then

 :term_date is not null

end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Kishore on 02/01/2012. IM 6394
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error_dist('0331');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;
-- End of change

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_ID
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure generate_id is
 temp_number number;
 temp_pref VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 temp_pref := substr(lpad(replace(upper(:s_customer_name),' ',''),3,'X'),1,3);
 --
 -- generate new number
 select nvl(max(to_number(substr(consignee_id,7))),0)+1
 into temp_number
 from consignee
 where consignee_id like temp_pref ||'-CS%'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 --
 :s_consignee_id := temp_pref ||'-CS'||
 lpad(to_char(temp_number),4,'0');
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select customer_id, customer_type, substr(name,1,35), substr(to_char (eff_date,'mm-dd-yy'),1,10),to_char(term_date,'mm-dd-yy') from customers where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and customer_type != :g_customer_type and ( customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_customer_id or upper(name) like :ctrl_blk_1.s_customer_id || '%') and (:ctrl_blk_1.inclterm='Y' or to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.ctrl_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy'),'mm/dd/yyyy') between eff_date and nvl (term_date,to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.ctrl_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy'),'mm/dd/yyyy') +1)) order by 1

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 --show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK)); -- Commented by Kishore on 02/01/2012. IM 6394
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-FORM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 --:global.program_version:='01';
 --:global.program_version:='02'; -- IM 2691
 --:global.program_version:='03'; -- incease the size of city field
 --:global.program_version:='04'; -- add int flag
 --:global.program_version:='05'; -- Subclass OG_COMMON; IM:5372
 --:global.program_version:='06'; -- IM 5434
 --:global.program_version:='07'; -- IM 5434 -- eff_date and last_modified_date to local
 --:global.program_version:='08'; -- IM 5434 -- CUSTOMER id lov to for local time zone.

 --:global.program_version:='10'; -- IM 6394
 --:global.program_version:='11'; -- -- duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 -- :global.program_version:='12'; -- SCR 20857
 
-- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 :global.program_version := '01';

 execute_trigger('sbc_banner');
 check_package_failure;
 
 default_value(' ','global.time_zone_enabled');
 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 :global.time_zone_enabled :='Y';
 else
 :global.time_zone_enabled :='N';
 end if; 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :ctrl_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :ctrl_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
end;
